headline: 8 vault contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum; GitHub repo and Spearbit/Cantina audit surfaced; GROVE token mentioned but address not pinned; 65 total Morpho vaults per curator page, only partial enumeration achieved.

findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag searches not directly reachable (etherscan searchHandler blocked); Morpho curator page at app.morpho.org/ethereum/curator/steakhouse-financial surfaced via search showing 65 total vaults, $1.72B deposits. Ethplorer confirmed 0xBEEF01735c132Ada46AA9aA4c54623cAA92A64CB as STEAKUSDC on Ethereum. Forbes block-explorer link surfaced 0xbeef07e929f84466a591de130e4154667214f491 as STEAKEURCV on Ethereum. Direct Etherscan fetch not attempted due to fetch-limit constraints.

D2: Docs hub at steakhouse.financial/docs confirmed (fetched); no single 'Deployed contracts' index page found; vault addresses are scattered across per-product docs pages. The High Yield Instant product page (surfaced via search) listed 6 vault addresses across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum. No single deployed_contracts_doc URL found; the closest is the per-product docs sub-pages. App page at app.steakhouse.financial fetched, showing asset distribution by chain (Mainnet $964M, Monad $800M, Katana $61M, Arbitrum $32M, Polygon $31M, Unichain $362K) but no explicit contract addresses.

D3: One audit found and fetched: Spearbit/Cantina web2 app review (Sept 11-14, 2025) at cantina.xyz/portfolio/2a4be4db-5c1d-4cf4-8a14-0d2f08fad274. This is a frontend (Web2 app) audit, not a smart contract audit. 7 low-risk findings. No contract addresses in scope. No smart contract audit PDF linked from the protocol website or audit_links (none were pinned). The app footer references 'Secured by Spearbit' linking to this Cantina report.

D4: GitHub org is Steakhouse-Financial (discovered via Cantina audit page referencing github.com/Steakhouse-Financial/app). Commit SHA caeaa12a3b65516e9d16ce3984386f9081647db1 pinned for the app repo. No deployment artifact files (broadcast/run-latest.json, deployments.json) could be fetched due to URL allowlist restrictions on newly constructed GitHub paths. Protocol GitHub was listed as 'none recorded' in pinned context; org URL discovered this run.

D5: Protocol operates across 9 chains per pinned context. App page confirmed Mainnet, Monad, Katana, Arbitrum, Polygon, Unichain distribution. Morpho curator page confirms Ethereum, Base, Katana, Polygon, Unichain, Arbitrum. Solana vaults exist (Kamino-based, per docs search snippet). Corn chain mentioned in protocol.chains but zero addresses surfaced for Corn. Monad chain shows large TVL ($800M) but no contract addresses surfaced — likely testnet or recently launched. No addresses found for Solana, Monad, Corn, or Unichain.

D6: Morpho curator page shows 65 vaults managed by Steakhouse Financial; only 7 EVM addresses surfaced via search snippets this run (well under the 50-child cap). Full enumeration of all 65 vaults not achieved — blocked by fetch limits and the absence of a single factory enumeration endpoint. The Morpho protocol itself is the vault factory, not Steakhouse-controlled. Kamino (Solana) vault enumeration not attempted.

D7: All surfaced addresses classified as 'vault' (ERC-4626 Morpho MetaMorpho vaults) or 'other' (SHF v1 custom vault). No admin multisig, proxy admin, timelock, owner EOA, or guardian addresses surfaced this run — these would require on-chain reads of each vault's owner()/guardian()/curator() methods which could not be performed due to no pre-built surfacer URLs and fetch-limit exhaustion. GROVE token mentioned on X (10B ERC-20 on Ethereum) but address not found in fetched sources.

D8: All 8 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to search result snippets from docs pages or block explorer aggregators that appeared in web_search results. No address was fabricated from memory. The Morpho curator page URL (app.morpho.org/ethereum/curator/steakhouse-financial) appeared in search results confirming 65 vaults and curator role but yielded only a snippet — full fetch not attempted.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the protocol website (fetched), docs hub (fetched), app frontend (fetched), Cantina audit page (fetched), and two web searches. 8 vault contract addresses surfaced across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum. Steakhouse acts as a risk curator on Morpho (65 vaults total per Morpho's curator page), not as a smart contract deployer — vault contracts are Morpho MetaMorpho instances. No admin multisig, proxy admin, or GROVE token address was pinned due to fetch limits and the absence of a dedicated deployments index page. grade=unknown because no on-chain reads were completed (surfacer URLs require pinned addresses, none were pre-built) and the full vault enumeration (65 vaults) was not achieved.

Docs hub confirmed at this URL, covering Collateral Risk Framework, Risk Monitoring, Product Overview, Market Overview, Documents sections. No single deployed-contracts index page present.

App frontend confirmed; shows $1.89B noncustodial assets, 163.9K depositors, chain distribution: Mainnet $964M (51%), Monad $800M (42%), Katana $61M, Arbitrum $32M, Polygon $31M, Unichain $362K. Vault strategies: Prime, High Yield, Term, Turbo. 'Secured by Spearbit' links to Cantina audit.

protocol_metadata.about: Steakhouse Financial is a risk curator and DeFi advisory firm that operates institutional-grade stablecoin yield vaults built on the Morpho lending protocol across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Katana, Polygon, and Unichain, with Kamino-based vaults on Solana. Users deposit stablecoins (USDC, USDT, EURCV, PYUSD) into curated ERC-4626 MetaMorpho vaults; Steakhouse allocates capital across Morpho lending markets using collateral risk frameworks covering blue-chip crypto and real-world assets (RWAs). The protocol also operates Grove, an institutional credit-and-liquidity protocol that routes capital dynamically across lending venues to support onchain credit origination and stablecoin liquidity bootstrapping. Steakhouse earns performance fees as a percentage of gross vault yield, with the remainder distributed to depositors.
